a new polymorphism in the intron 3 of the TP53 gene (PIN3) is a modifier of germline mutations of the TP53 tumour suppressor gene, and that this new polymorphism is associated with a 19-year difference in the mean age of the first cancer diagnosis of TP53 mutation carriers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
genetic modifiers in the TP53 tumour suppressor gene, which is the gene most frequently involved in human cancer.

the study of the genetic modifiers that can influence the phenotypic expression of germline mutations in the TP53 tumour suppressor gene, which is associated with the Li-Fraumemi Syndrome (LFS) and the Li-Fraummeli-like Syndrome (LFL), two rare autosomal dominant cancer susceptibility syndromes.
the study of the genetic and molecular basis of the phenotypic variability of LFS/LFL and the identification of genetic modifiers in the TP53 tumour suppressor gene pathway.

the TP53 PIN3 polymorphism is a genetic modifier of the Li-Fraumemi syndrome.
